unit.description: unit of linear distance measurement used to measure precipitation accumulation

aorc:statistics.title: Precipitation Accumultation Statistics
aorc:statistics.description: A collection of statistics computed using accumulated AORC precipitation data for a transposed watershed within the transposition domain

count.title: Count
count.description: Count of gridded precipitation cells used to calculate accumulation measurements

normalized_mean.title: Normalized Mean Precipitation
normalized_mean.description: Mean of precipitation accumulation values divided by corresponding ATLAS14 data values for normalization

aorc:transform.title: Transform
aorc:transform.description: A 3x3 matrix stored as a flat array of 9 elements in row major order. Since the last row is always 0,0,1 it can be omitted, in which case only 6 elements are recorded. Refers to the transform applied to the original watershed geometry to yield the provided watershed geometry

aorc:overlapping_overall_rank.title: Overlapping Overall Rank
aorc:overlapping_overall_rank.description: Overall rank of storm, starting at 1, which does not distinguish between storm with temporal extents which overlap and temporal extents which do not overlap. This means that the number 1 ranked 72 hour duration storm could have a temporal extent from 1979-01-01 00:00 to 1979-01-04 00:00 and the number 2 ranked 72 hour duration storm could have a temporal extent from 1979-01-02 00:00 to 1979-01-05 00:00, meaning the number 1 and number 2 storms share 48 hours of overlapping precipitation data.

aorc:overlapping_year_rank.title: Overlapping Year Rank
aorc:overlapping_year_rank.description: Rank of storm within its year, starting at 1, which does not distinguish between storm with temporal extents which overlap and temporal extents which do not overlap. This means that the number 1 ranked 72 hour duration storm for the year 1979 could have a temporal extent from 1979-01-01 00:00 to 1979-01-04 00:00 and the number 2 ranked 72 hour duration storm for the year 1979 could have a temporal extent from 1979-01-02 00:00 to 1979-01-05 00:00, meaning the number 1 and number 2 storms share 48 hours of overlapping precipitation data.

aorc:non_overlapping_overall_rank.title: Non-overlapping Overall Rank
aorc:non_overlapping_overall_rank.description: Overall rank of storm, starting at 1, which does not allow storms with temporal extents which overlap, assigning storms which would overlap with higher ranked storms a value of -1. This means that if the number 1 ranked 72 hour duration storm had a temporal extent from 1979-01-01 00:00 to 1979-01-04 00:00, any storm identified which overlapped with that temporal extent would be assigned the value -1.

aorc:non_overlapping_year_rank.title: Non-overlapping Year Rank
aorc:non_overlapping_year_rank.description: Rank of storm within its year, starting at 1, which does not allow storms with temporal extents which overlap, assigning storms which would overlap with higher ranked storms a value of -1. This means that if the number 1 ranked 72 hour duration storm for the year 1979 had a temporal extent from 1979-01-01 00:00 to 1979-01-04 00:00, any storm identified which overlapped with that temporal extent would be assigned the value -1.
